bundle.shortDescription: Installs Ascendancy server extras for Create: Ultimate Selection 2
bundle.longDescription: Adds the HitnMis server-side extras (Crafting on a Stick, Quark, Supplementaries, and more) on top of an existing Create: Ultimate Selection 2 modpack install. Auto-detects CurseForge and Prism Launcher instances, downloads the current mod manifest from hitnmis.gg, and auto-cleans retired mods.
